lines.zh: 尖牙嘶嘶作响，朝你逼近。
lines.en: Hive Fangs hisses, closing in on you.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意，尖牙走过。
lines.en: A chill runs down your spine as Hive Fangs passes by.
It creaks closer to you.
Hive Fangs growls, ready to attack.
It taps the ground with its fangs.

lines.zh: 你听到远处尖牙的声音。
lines.en: You hear the distant hiss of a Hive Fangs.
One point of health is enough to bite.

lines.zh: 尖牙发出咯吱声，向前移动。
lines.en: Hive Fangs creaks, moving forward.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地接近，发出低沉的嘶声。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, hissing low.

lines.zh: 尖牙的呼吸声在黑暗中回荡。
lines.en: The breath of Hive Fangs echoes in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我从地里探出来，挪向你。
lines.en: I poke out of the ground and slide to you.

lines.zh: 石缝里，我一点点挪过去。
lines.en: Through the cracks in stone, I creep closer.
Hive Fangs waits silently.
It lies lazily in the shadow.
It stares at you silently.

lines.zh: 尖牙紧盯着周围的动静。
lines.en: Hive Fangs watches the surroundings.
It patiently waits for prey.

lines.zh: 尖牙的眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam.

lines.zh: 它静静地趴着，不发出声响。
lines.en: It lies quietly, making no sound.
Hive Fangs waits quietly for an opportunity.
It lies quietly in the shadow.
It fixes you in its gaze silently.
I hide in the soil under your feet.
One fang left, and still I wait.
Until the Watcher speaks, I stay still.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风吹过我的牙尖。
lines.en: Bone-waste wind blows over my tips.
It snarls with its fangs in the air.

lines.zh: 地表裂开，我先露出牙尖。
lines.en: The ground splits; my tips show first.
Hive Fangs suddenly turns to you.
It stares at you, threatening.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着光芒，盯着你。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam, fixing on you.
It roars, staring at you.
Hive Fangs glares at you.
Fangs rise from the floor, fixed on you.
It stares at you, hissing.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，发出嘶声。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, hissing.
I look up at you from the dirt.
Every tip of me points at you.
The ground under your boots is moving.
I am waiting for your step.
The spot you stand on is my choice.

lines.zh: 我数着你鞋底离我多远。
lines.en: I count the steps you have left.
I hear your boots shaking.

lines.zh: 看天没意义，我埋在土里。
lines.en: Looking up won't help. I am below.
My shadow reaches you first.
Wherever you run, the soil follows.

lines.zh: 尖牙发出嘶嘶声，靠近你身体。
lines.en: Hive Fangs hisses, closing in on you.

lines.zh: 它锋利的獠牙反射着光芒。
lines.en: Its sharp fangs glint menacingly.

lines.zh: 它的目光如炬，盯着你的心脏。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces you, fixating on your heart.

lines.zh: 被它的目光注视，你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Its stare fills you with dread.
I lick the taste of blood from the soil.

lines.zh: 它逼近你，唾液滴落在你身上。
lines.en: It creeps closer, saliva dripping on you.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到土面那么宽。
lines.en: I open my mouth as wide as the soil surface.
You feel the heat from its breath.
It prepares to leap for your heart.

lines.zh: 它的目光如刀，割裂你的心灵。
lines.en: Its gaze cuts deep into your soul.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一只尖牙，它咆哮着反击。
lines.en: You collide with a Hive Fang, which roars in retaliation.

lines.zh: 它用獠牙撞击你，试图击倒你。
lines.en: It collides with you, using its fangs to try and knock you down.

lines.zh: 你的攻击反弹，打在尖牙身上。
lines.en: Your attack rebounds, striking the Hive Fang.

lines.zh: 它从四面八方撞击你，试图削弱你。
lines.en: It collides from all sides, trying to weaken you.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的冲击力量。
lines.en: You feel the force of its impacts.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，但牙很尖。
lines.en: One point of health, but these fangs are sharp.

lines.zh: 你的攻击击中了它的薄弱点。
lines.en: Your attack hits its vulnerable spot.

lines.zh: 它猛烈撞击你，试图把你击飞。
lines.en: It collides with you, trying to knock you away.

lines.zh: 你的攻击被它的撞击弹开。
lines.en: Your attack is repelled by its collision.

lines.zh: 它的撞击如同风暴般猛烈。
lines.en: Its collisions are like a storm.

lines.zh: 它寻找配偶，发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, growling low.

lines.zh: 它寻找着同类，发出求偶的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 我的牙在土下互相敲着。
lines.en: My teeth knock against each other under the soil.
It searches for a potential mate.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的嘶嘶声，寻找同伴。
lines.en: It hisses in search of a companion.

lines.zh: 它寻找着可以交流的生物。
lines.en: It searches for a fellow to communicate with.

lines.zh: 它的声音在荒野中回荡。
lines.en: Its voice reverberates in the wilderness.

lines.zh: 它寻找着同类，进行求偶。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, seeking to breed.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在寂静中显得格外响亮。
lines.en: Its call stands out in the silence.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的嘶嘶声，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It hisses in search of a mate.

lines.zh: 饥渴的集群之牙在你周围徘徊。
lines.en: The Hive Fangs loiters around you, hungry.
The Hive Fangs bares its fangs at you.
You sense the Hive Fangs' threat.

lines.zh: 集群之牙注视着你的每一步。
lines.en: The Hive Fangs watch your every step.

lines.zh: 你感到一股冷意，来自尖牙。
lines.en: You feel a chill from the Hive Fangs.

lines.zh: 尖牙的叫声穿透你的灵魂。
lines.en: The Hive Fangs' call pierces your soul.

lines.zh: 它的声音比任何声音都更让你毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its voice is more unsettling than any sound.

lines.zh: 你必须避开尖牙的目光。
lines.en: You must avert your gaze from the Hive Fangs.

lines.zh: 尖牙的呼吸声令你心惊胆战。
lines.en: The Hive Fangs' breath is terrifying.

lines.zh: 你感到一种无法抵抗的吸引力。
lines.en: You feel an irresistible pull towards the Hive Fangs.
It locks onto your position.
It threatens you.

lines.zh: 我在你影子下面张开嘴。
lines.en: I open my mouth beneath your shadow.
I have the strength of one fang.

lines.zh: 我从你脚下冒出来，一排牙。
lines.en: A row of teeth rises out of the ground under you.

lines.zh: 我的牙从你脚下的土里顶出。
lines.en: My teeth push up through the soil beneath you.
Its fangs point towards you.

lines.zh: 它的目光如鹰一般锐利。
lines.en: Its gaze is as sharp as an eagle's.
It has taken an interest in you.
It prepares to consume you.
The Watcher pointed at you. I come.

lines.zh: 你的脚印给我留了记号。
lines.en: Your footprints left me a mark.
This ground answers to me now.

lines.zh: 我认准了你左脚的脚踝。
lines.en: I have picked out your ankle.
On the flesh plains you stand out.
The moment you stop, I grow.
Its claws prepare to strike.

lines.zh: 它的目光如刀锋般锋利。
lines.en: Its gaze is as sharp as a knife.
It prepares to tear you apart with its fangs.
Its form rapidly approaches.

lines.zh: 它的声音让你无法呼吸。
lines.en: Its voice leaves you breathless.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸几乎让你窒息。
lines.en: Its breath almost suffocates you.
Its movements are as swift as lightning.
Its gaze is full of hunger.

lines.zh: 它的爪子准备狠狠地抓你。
lines.en: Its claws prepare to grab you savagely.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让人无法躲避。
lines.en: Its attack leaves no room for evasion.
My tips are pushing up through the ground.
The loose dirt is creaking. Hear it?
I ring around you in a circle.
One more step and I reach you.
I aim for your feet, not your head.

lines.zh: 我的尖先从影子里冒出来。
lines.en: My points surface from your shadow first.
The crack under you is opening.

lines.zh: 观者只说了一个词：现在。
lines.en: The Watcher said one word: now.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也找准了你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I found you.
This bite only rises. It never retracts.
Sibilant bite, pierces skin.
Sharp fangs tear muscle.

lines.zh: 你感受到了我的獠牙吗？
lines.en: Feel my fangs.
Lethal fang strike.
Teeth sink in deep.

lines.zh: 我从下往上，咬进你的小腿。
lines.en: I bite up into your calf from below.
Deadly kiss.

lines.zh: 我合拢时，泥和血一起响。
lines.en: When I close, mud and blood sound together.
Tear apart.
Death's embrace.
Up through the soles of your feet!
Crack. My fangs bite your boot.
A row of fangs closes at once.
Jumping will not save you.
The sound of bone is lovely.
After this bite, I am gone.
Whisper of the summoner.
Appears in darkness.
Sacrifice of the viewer.
Devours souls.
Summoned by the viewer.
Shadow in the dark.
Drains life.
Guardian of the viewer.
Howl in the shadow.
Painful scream.
The dirt loosens. I come out.

lines.zh: 观者在上面画了一个圈。
lines.en: The Watcher drew a circle up there.

lines.zh: 我从骨荒原的裂缝冒头。
lines.en: I surface through a crack in the bone waste.
Blood soaks the soil. I wake.
Only one fang grew. It is enough.

lines.zh: 你听见地底下的磨牙声吗。
lines.en: Hear the grinding under the ground?
Clods turn over. Here I am.
This patch of ground is marked.
I come from below. One bite is enough.

lines.zh: 窄窄一条裂缝也藏得下我。
lines.en: A narrow crack can hold me.
